## Summary / Resumo
- Describe what changed and why.

## Branch & Release Checklist
- [ ] Target branch is **`dev`** (or this is a release PR from **`dev` → `main`** awaiting maintainer approval)
- [ ] **Zero API keys or secrets** included in commits, diffs, or exported JSON files
- [ ] **100% non-destructive** guarantee preserved (zero deletion of Zotero items, attachments, or collections)
- [ ] Syntax checks (`node --check`) and bilingual (`en-US` / `pt-BR`) tests passed
- [ ] Updated both `README.md` and `README.pt-BR.md` when adding user-facing features
